goal: Ship a rough analytics dashboard before the demo.

success_criteria.statement: Admin clicks Export and downloads a CSV of the filtered orders.
success_criteria.verify: Manual: filter orders, click Export, open the file, row count matches the table.

success_criteria.statement: Non-admins never see the Export button.
success_criteria.verify: Automated: request as a non-admin returns 403 and the button is absent.

assumptions: The orders table already supports server-side filtering.
open_questions: Which metrics matter most is still unsettled.
